## Learning Objectives

By the end of this week you should be able to:

1. Describe the forward diffusion process and its closed-form marginal at any timestep.
2. Explain the reparameterization that lets a network predict noise instead of the clean image.
3. Write the training objective for a denoising diffusion probabilistic model.
4. Describe ancestral sampling and the speed/quality trade-off of the sampler.
5. Explain classifier-free guidance and conditional generation.
6. Relate diffusion models to score matching and to VAEs.
